jamie_support: Hi @acme_mobile_josh — we saw your support ticket about intermittent 400s from /v1/rerank. Can you paste the raw request body + headers (no redaction) for one failed request?
acme_mobile_josh: hey jamie, pasting raw body we logged from the mobile proxy (will trim API key):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: text/plain
X-Request-Id: req-9f3c

{
  "payload": "{\"items\": \"[{\\\"id\\\": \"c1\", \\\"text\\\": \\\"candidate A\\\"}]\", \"top_k\": null }"
}
```
jamie_support: thanks. that looks like the body is a wrapper object with a stringified JSON in `payload` and Content-Type text/plain. our rerank endpoint expects application/json and `items` as an array — that stringified inner JSON will be treated as a string, not an object/array, causing the 400 error: `items must be an array`.
daria_engineer: repro steps I used: take that exact body, send to /v1/rerank with Content-Type: text/plain -> server returns 400 with error message: `items: expected array, got string`. If you send the inner JSON directly with Content-Type: application/json it works.
acme_mobile_josh: oh interesting — our mobile SDK does `JSON.stringify(body)` and our CDN proxy (legacy) wraps requests into `{ payload: <body> }` for observability. so double-encoded. the SDK also incorrectly sets content-type to text/plain in older builds.
jamie_support: OK that explains the intermittent nature (only mobile via proxy). Quick options: 1) Short-term workaround: set proxy to pass-through for /v1/rerank (no wrapper) and ensure Content-Type preserved. 2) Client fix: stop double-stringifying and set Content-Type: application/json.
daria_engineer: also adding a server-side tolerance check could help (attempt parse if payload is string and contains JSON) but that has risks. If you want us to implement tolerant parsing behind a feature flag for your org we can open an internal ticket.
acme_mobile_josh: we prefer client/proxy fix. can you provide a minimal repro script I can run locally to confirm?
daria_engineer: sure — repro (curl):
```
# will return 400
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \n  -d '{"payload":"{\"items\": \"[{\\\"id\\\":\\\"c1\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"candidate A\\\"}]\",\"top_k\":null}'}'

# correct (200):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"items":[{"id":"c1","text":"candidate A"}],"top_k":1}'
```
jamie_support: I filed SUP-3421 and linked the logs (req-9f3c). @daria_engineer can you add the repro steps and suggested client patch to the ticket? :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Created ticket SUP-3421 assigned to @daria_engineer (priority: P2)
daria_engineer: noted, I'll add a brief writeup for the mobile team and include the curl repro + recommended client change (remove extra JSON.stringify, set Content-Type to application/json). Also adding note: if proxy must wrap, ask them to send wrapper.payload as raw JSON not stringified (i.e., keep payload as object).
